args.code:
alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"
target = "a0jybs5xsmzmj6"

# For each character in target, find the original character
# Algorithm: index_in_alphabet(input_char) + 19 mod 37 = index_in_alphabet(target_char)
# So: index_in_alphabet(input_char) = (index_in_alphabet(target_char) - 19) mod 37

result = ""
for c in target:
    target_idx = alphabet.index(c)
    input_idx = (target_idx - 19) % 37
    result += alphabet[input_idx]

password = "pass{" + result + "}"
print(f"Target string: {target}")
print(f"Result inner: {result}")
print(f"Full password: {password}")
print(f"Length: {len(password)}")
